blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and 3D generation have expanded 3D understanding and synthesis. However, beyond visual fidelity, task-specific correctness grounded in 3D evidence remains a major challenge. We argue that building reliable 3D systems requires not only stronger generation and reasoning, but also verification feedback that identifies unmet requirements and explains their violations, allowing systems to reflect on and refine their outputs. Such feedback must integrate multi-view observations and distinguish genuine inconsistencies from projection-dependent appearances. We make three contributions. First, we introduce 3DVerifierBench, a benchmark spanning 10 tasks that evaluates decisions, rejection explanations, and responses to controlled changes in specifications and candidates. A human study reveals a 21.6 percentage-point gap between humans and the strongest tested model, GPT-6 Astra, while explanation-aware analysis exposes weaknesses in rejection reliability. Second, we analyze verification across fine-grained factual categories, exposing errors in values and target binding. We develop a scalable pipeline combining multi-view fact extraction, controlled 3D editing, and native annotations to produce 14,126 training examples with contradiction explanations and linked counterfactuals. Third, we examine how verification could support 3D generation through candidate selection and recursive refinement. In human-labeled sixteen-candidate pools, oracle selection improves complete factual success from 26.7% to 90.0%. In a separate eight-input study, human-guided recursive refinement satisfies all seven requirements for every input, compared with three under parallel Oracle@8. Together, our benchmark, analysis, and data pipeline establish a foundation for models to reflect on 3D content through reliable verification feedback.
blocks.zh: 最近在多模式大语言模型(MLLMs)和3D生成方面的进步已经扩大了3D的理解和合成. 然而,除了视觉忠贞外,基于三维证据的具体任务正确性仍然是一个重大挑战。 我们主张,建设可靠的三维系统不仅需要更强大的生成和推理,还需要核查反馈,找出未满足的要求并解释其违规情况,使系统能够反思和完善其产出. 这种反馈必须结合多观点观察,区分真正的不一致和依赖预测的外观. 我们作出了三项贡献。 首先,我们引入了3D验证器Bench, 这个基准涵盖10项任务, 评估决定,拒绝解释, 以及对控制下的规格和候选人变化的反应。 一项人类研究揭示出人类与最强测试模型GPT-6 Astra之间21.6%的差距,而解释-认识分析则暴露出拒绝可靠性的弱点. 第二,我们分析各种精细事实类别的核查,揭露价值错误和目标约束。 我们开发了可伸缩的管道,将多视图事实提取,控制3D编辑,以及本土说明结合起来,以产生14,126个培训例子,并附有自相矛盾的解释和相联的反事实. 第三,我们审查核查如何能够通过候选人的甄选和递归完善来支持3D生成。 在标有人类标记的16名候选人的集合中,甲骨文选择使完全的事实成功率从26.7%提高到90.0%。 在一项单独的八种输入法研究中,由人指导的递归性改进满足了每项输入的所有七项要求,而平行的甲骨文@8项下有三项要求。 我们的基准、分析和数据管道共同为模型打下基础,通过可靠的核查反馈对3D内容进行反思。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent advances in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have extended visual understanding toward increasingly complex spatial reasoning, while progress in 3D generation enables the synthesis and editing of assets with detailed geometry and appearance ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . Together, these developments bring models closer to understanding, creating, and manipulating 3D content through natural language. However, generated assets can still contain geometric artifacts, missing components, and inconsistencies with the requested attributes or structure ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Duggal et al., 2025 ) . Such errors limit their usefulness: An object may look convincing while failing the geometric or functional requirement for which it was created.
blocks.zh: 最近在多式大语言模型(MLLMs)方面取得的进展,将视觉理解扩展至日益复杂的空间推理,而3D生成方面的进展使得能够合成和编辑有详细几何和外观的资产(徐等,2025;邓等,2025;李等,2026)。 这些发展共同使模型通过自然语言更接近理解,创建,并操纵了3D内容. 然而所生成的资产仍然可以包含几何文物,缺失组件,以及与所请求的属性或结构不一致(Wu等,2024;Duggal等,2025.). 此类错误限制了其效用: 某一物体可能看起来令人信服,但却未能达到其创建时的几何或功能要求。

blocks.en: To improve these systems, existing research has pursued broader pretraining, targeted post-training, and test-time scaling. These approaches strengthen perceptual representations, align outputs with instructions or preferences, and allocate additional computation to candidate search ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) . A system can also reflect on its output and use feedback to guide a subsequent attempt ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) . For 3D content, this requires identifying which requirements are unmet and explaining why. We study this step through 3D verification , which checks a candidate against explicit requirements and explains contradictions. Despite progress in general visual verification ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , the reliability of such feedback across diverse 3D tasks remains underexplored.
blocks.zh: 为了改进这些系统,现有的研究力求扩大培训前培训、有针对性的培训后培训和试验时间的扩大。 这些办法加强了观念表述,使产出与指示或偏好一致,并为候选人查询分配了额外计算(徐等,2025;邓等,2025;叶等,2025;周等,2025)。 一个系统还可以反思其输出,并使用反馈来指导后续尝试(Madaan等,2023;Shinn等,2023.). 就三维内容而言,这需要确定哪些要求没有得到满足并解释原因。 我们通过三维核查来研究这个步骤, 尽管在一般视觉核查方面取得了进展(Zhang等,2026b.),但是在各种3D任务中,这种反馈的可靠性仍未得到充分探讨。

blocks.en: Realizing this goal in 3D, however, involves challenges beyond those of image-based verification. Native 3D perception requires specialized representations and language alignment, as illustrated by point-cloud language models ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ) ; these capabilities cannot simply be assumed in an image-based MLLM. Although multi-view rendering makes 3D assets accessible to such models, it provides partial, projection-dependent observations rather than the complete geometry. A verifier must consequently associate parts across views, resolve occlusion, and distinguish geometric differences from changes in viewpoint or appearance. For grasping, identity, and motion, it must further establish whether the specific constraint holds, rather than merely recognize the object or action. The two cases in Figure 1 illustrate this distinction: GPT-6 Astra recognizes a rightward collapse but misses its unnatural motion, and accepts identity preservation despite a changed chin and face outline. These failures motivate both a systematic assessment of current verification ability and supervision that connects judgments to the relevant 3D evidence.
blocks.zh: 然而,在3D中实现这一目标涉及的挑战超出了基于图像的核查。 原生的3D感知需要专门的表示和语言相接,由点-云语言模型(徐等,2025;邓等,2025)所说明;这些能力不能简单地在基于图像的MLLM中假设. 虽然多视图渲染使得这种模型可以访问到3D资产,但它提供了部分的,依赖投影的观测,而不是完整的几何. 因此,核查人必须将不同观点联系起来,解决隔离问题,区分几何差异和观点或外观的变化。 为了掌握、确定身份和采取行动,它必须进一步确定具体限制是否有效,而不仅仅是承认目标或行动。 图1中的两起案例说明了这种区别:GPT-6 Astra承认右向倒塌,但错过了它的非自然运动,尽管下巴和相貌轮廓改变,还是接受身份保护. 这些失败既促使系统地评估目前的核查能力,也促使监督将判决与相关的立体证据联系起来。

blocks.en: Motivated by these challenges, our work addresses three connected questions, from measuring the capability gap to supporting its development and examining its downstream value.
blocks.zh: 在这些挑战的推动下,我们的工作涉及三个相互关联的问题,从衡量能力差距到支持其发展和审查其下游价值。

blocks.en: How far are current MLLMs from human-level 3D verification? We introduce 3DVerifierBench , a human-reviewed benchmark with 2,581 examples across ten complementary tasks. A common answer-and-explanation interface covers object properties, parts, relations, affordance regions, grasps, identity, reference geometry, and motion. In addition to individual judgments, linked counterfactuals test whether predictions respond consistently to changes in requirements or candidates. Our experiments show that humans achieve 87.8% task overall accuracy, exceeding the strongest tested model, GPT-6 Astra, by 21.6 percentage points (Figure 1 , bottom). The benchmark thus establishes both the breadth and the remaining limitations of current 3D verification.
blocks.zh: 当前MLLMs距离人级3D验证有多远?. 我们引入了3D验证器Bench,这是经人审查的基准,有2 581个例子,涉及10个互补任务。 一个常见的解答与解析接口涵盖对象属性,部件,关系,付接区域,抓取,身份,参考几何,和运动等. 除了个别判断外,连通的反事实检验预测是否一致地对需求变化或候选人作出反应。 我们的实验表明,人类实现了87.8%的任务整体精确度,超过了最强的被测试模型GPT-6 Astra的21.6%(图1,下方). 因此,基准既确定了当前三维核查的广度,也确定了其余的局限性。

blocks.en: What capabilities and supervision are needed to strengthen 3D verification? Our analysis shows that recognizing an object or action does not ensure verification of the decisive attribute, target, or geometric condition. Identity preservation, grasp validity, and motion compliance are particularly weak, while explanation checks reveal that even correct rejections can miss the reference contradiction. These findings motivate supervision that links a decision to a specific fact and its evidence. Motivated also by prior work on training multimodal verifiers ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , we develop an automated pipeline for large-scale verification data curation, combining multi-view fact extraction, controlled requirement and candidate changes, and native task annotations. With this pipeline, we produce a large-scale dataset with 14,126 samples across diverse tasks, which provides a data foundation for scaling domain-specific verification supervision.
blocks.zh: 加强三维核查需要哪些能力和监督? 我们的分析表明,承认某一物体或行动并不能确保核查决定性的属性、目标或几何条件。 身份保存,抓取有效性,运动遵守尤其薄弱,而解释检查显示,即使正确的拒绝也可能错过参考矛盾. 这些调查结果促使监督将决定与具体事实及其证据联系起来。 此外,在培训多式联运核查员(Zhang等,2026年b)的前期工作推动下,我们开发了用于大规模核查数据的自动管道,结合了多视图事实提取、控制要求和候选修改以及本土任务说明。 通过这一管道,我们制作一个大型数据集,其中包含14 126个不同任务的样本,为扩大特定领域核查监督提供了数据基础。

blocks.en: How can a 3D generation model reflect by verifying reliably? We examine both selection among existing candidates and recursive refinement of unsatisfied requirements. In human-labeled sixteen-candidate pools, oracle selection improves complete factual success by 63.3 percentage points . In a separate eight-input study, human-guided recursive refinement satisfies all seven requirements for every input, compared with three under parallel Oracle@8. Together, these results demonstrate substantial downstream headroom for reliable verification, connecting the capability gap and data foundation to the goal of reflection in 3D generation.
blocks.zh: 三维生成模型如何通过可靠验证来反映? 我们既审查现有候选人的甄选,又审查对不满意要求的不断改进。 在标有人类标记的16个候选人的人才库中,甲骨文选择使完全的事实成功率提高了63.3个百分点。 在一项单独的8个输入研究中,人类指导的再生精炼满足了每项输入的所有7个要求,而平行甲骨文的3个是8个。 这些结果加在一起表明下游有大量可靠的核查室,将能力差距和数据基础与三维生成的反射目标联系起来。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Recent 3D-language models connect native 3D representations to language and evaluate object, part, spatial, and embodied understanding ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . In parallel, 3D generation benchmarks and evaluators measure semantic alignment, human preference, geometric quality, and generation defects ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Jia et al., 2026 ; Duggal et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Together, these works substantially improve our ability to describe and assess 3D content. However, predicting a property or scoring an asset does not directly measure whether a model can verify a specific requirement , reject a plausible but incorrect candidate, and identify heterogeneous 3D evidence that makes it wrong. We focus on this verifier-side evaluation against human judgments, with scope comparisons to prior work in Figure 2 .
blocks.zh: 近期的3D语言模型将本地3D表达方式与语言相接并评价对象,部分,空间,并体现理解(徐等;邓等;2025;王等;2025a;张等;2026a.). 同时,3D生成基准和评估人员衡量语义一致、人类偏好、几何质量和生成缺陷(Wu等,2024;Zhang等,2025a; 张等,2025b;贾等,2026;杜格尔等,2025;赵等,2026. 这些工作共同大大提高了我们描述和评估三维内容的能力。 然而,对财产或资产评分的预测并不直接衡量一个模型是否能够核实某一具体要求,拒绝一个可信但不正确的候选人,并找出造成其错误的各种立体证据。 我们侧重于对照人类判断进行这一核查方评价,并将范围与图2中以前的工作进行比较。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Evaluation scope relative to prior work. Prior work ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Duggal et al., 2025 ) emphasizes preference, hierarchical quality, general visual verification, or asset-level consistency and artifact localization. Our 3DVerifierBench targets complementary verifier-side questions through explicit requirements, controlled counterfactuals, heterogeneous 3D evidence, and verification-guided refinement.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 与先前工作有关的评价范围。 先前的工作(张等,2025a; 张等, 2025b; 张等, 2026b; Duggal等, 2025.)强调偏好,分级质量,一般可视性验证,或资产级一致性和文物本地化. 我们的3D验证员Bench通过明确的要求、控制的反事实、不同的三维证据以及核查指导的改进,针对补充的核查方问题。

blocks.en: 3 3DVerifierBench
blocks.zh: 3 三维验证本奇

blocks.en: To benchmark AI against human verification, 3DVerifierBench unifies 10 tasks under a common interface, evaluating reliability across decisions, explanations, and consistency. Together, these dimensions assess whether a verifier can provide correct, informative, and consistent feedback for reflection in 3D generation.
blocks.zh: 为了将AI与人类核查作为基准,3D验证员Bench在共同界面下统一了10项任务,评价了决定、解释和一致性之间的可靠性。 这些维度一起评估一个核查者是否能够提供正确、信息丰富和一致的反馈,以便在3D生成中进行反思。

blocks.en: 4 Dataset and Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 4 数据集和基准建设

blocks.en: To support reliable verification feedback, supervision should identify not only whether a candidate is wrong, but which requirement is contradicted by the evidence . We therefore combine existing 3D resources with controlled interventions and native supervision, using three complementary strategies to construct task-specific data. The pipeline is shown in Figure 4 with details provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 为了支持可靠的核查反馈,监督部门不仅应查明候选人是否有错误,而且应查明哪些要求与证据相矛盾。 因此,我们将现有的三维资源与受控干预和本土监督相结合,利用三个互补战略来构建具体任务的数据。 输油管如图4所示,详情见附录B。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Our pipeline. Reviewed evidence establishes positive anchors. Spec-CF changes the requirement under fixed evidence, whereas Cand-CF changes the candidate under the original requirement. Native annotations and task-specific evidence complement these controlled mutations. Automated checks, model-assisted review, and human review together produce the benchmark.

blocks.en:
• Controlled Counterfactual Construction. For {Object, Part, Mat., Ground., Relation, Aff. Reg., Grasp}, we combine object-level assets and multi-view evidence from 3DGen-Bench, DB-3DME, and Hi3DBench ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Jia et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) with part annotations from PartNeXt and GAPartNet and grasp supervision
from ACRONYM ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Geng et al., 2023 ; Eppner et al., 2021 ) .
Starting from a positive anchor ( a , σ , True ) (a,\sigma,\mathrm{True}) where candidate a a satisfies a reviewed specification σ \sigma , we construct negative pairs via two counterfactual mechanisms:
Specification-side counterfactuals ( Spec-CF ) modify a key requirement while fixing a a , producing ( a , σ ′ , False ) (a,\sigma^{\prime},\mathrm{False}) .
Candidate-side counterfactuals ( Cand-CF ) modify the asset, marked region, part pair, or contact while fixing the specification, producing ( a ′ , σ , False ) (a^{\prime},\sigma,\mathrm{False}) .
Native annotations take precedence over synthetic edits when available, and candidate evaluation links are retained only when both records share identical model-visible claims. For Affordance Region, negative claims are verified by human review.
Two domain experts manually spot-check 10% of the outputs at each
model-assisted review stage shown in Figure 4 ,
including the two reviewer checkpoints in Spec-CF, the final pair review
in Spec-CF, and the consistency review in Cand-CF. • Parametric Data Synthesis. For {Identity}, we leverage FaceScape’s bilinear model ( Yang et al., 2020 ) to construct 200 balanced face pairs.
Specifically, identity variations are sampled using standardized identity coordinates, with labels assigned based on whether these identity coefficients are modified. To ensure that these parameter shifts yield human-perceptible identity differences, 6 domain experts were invited to establish explicit thresholds and validate the generated pairs.
To systematically evaluate robustness against non-identity attributes, i.e. , expression and texture , we vary them as nuisance factors across 4 conditions: (1) nearly gray texture with minimal changes,
(2) texture changes only,
(3) expression changes only,
(4) changes to both. • Expert-Guided Data Construction. For {FineGeo., Motion}, each has 6 domain experts guiding data construction and annotation.
For FineGeo., we apply Laplacian diffusion ( Desbrun et al., 1999 ) to ground-truth T-LESS models ( Hodan et al., 2017 ) , with experts selecting surface regions and perturbation parameters.
Original and perturbed models yield positive and negative photograph-CAD comparisons against fixed reference photographs.
For Motion, we combine reference motions from AnimalML3D ( Yang et al., 2024 ) with sequences generated by AnimateAnyMesh ( Wu et al., 2025b ) and Animate3D ( Jiang et al., 2024 ) .
Experts classify motions as Correct , Unnatural Motion , Incorrect Motion , or Deformation Artifacts , retaining only samples with unanimous agreement.

blocks.en: When native labels already define the relevant distinction, we use them directly instead of forcing every task through the same editing backend. Part and relation annotations, action semantics, grasp outcomes, identity parameters, reference photographs, and reviewed motion sequences provide task-specific evidence for the corresponding claims. We also provide an analysis of human performance on its subset, which is detailed in Appendix G . We observe that the performance of existing MLLMs is still far behind humans. blocks.en: 5.3 Limitations of MLLMs in 3D Verification
blocks.zh: 5.3 在3D核查中限制最低限值

blocks.en: To identify concrete bottlenecks in reliable verification feedback, we present representative failures in Figure 5 . These examples reveal errors in fine-grained geometry, spatiotemporal validity, and the grounding of claims in visual evidence. We summarize them as ten failure modes in the findings below. Appendix H further provides details of category-wise quantitative analysis of these verification failures.
blocks.zh: 为了找出可靠核查反馈中的具体瓶颈,我们在图5中提出了有代表性的失败。 这些例子揭示出精细的几何学,spatiotemporal有效性,以及在视觉证据中索赔的依据等错误. 我们总结如下十种失败模式。 附 录 H还详细介绍了这些核查失败的分类定量分析。

blocks.en: Findings: Limitations of MLLMs in 3D Verification 1. Repeated structures miscounted. 2. Nonexistent parts hallucinated from claim premises. 3. Material descriptions accepted despite conflicting reflectance cues. 4. Highlighted regions assigned incorrect semantic part labels. 5. Direct contact inferred without checking actual spatial relations. 6. Action-specific affordances confused across similar controls. 7. Adjacent grasp contacts mistaken for opposing contacts. 8. Identity-altering shape changes mistaken for expression changes. 9. Local curvature and contour mismatches are overlooked despite multi-view evidence. 10. Deformation artifacts in motion sequences go undetected .
blocks.zh: 调查结果:3D核查中最低限值的局限性 1. 重复的结构计算错误。 2. 不存在的部件从索赔地点产生幻觉。 3. 尽管出现了相互矛盾的反射提示,但还是接受了材料说明。 4. 突出区域划出不正确的语义部分标签。 5. 在不检查实际空间关系的情况下推断出直接接触。 6. 具体行动的费用在类似的控制中混淆不清。 7. 相邻的联系人被误认为是对立的联系人。 8. 改变身份的形状变化被误认为是表达变化。 9. 尽管存在多视图证据,但忽略了局部曲率和轮廓不匹配。 10. 运动序列中的变形文物未被发现。

blocks.en: 5.4 How Does Evidence Representation Affect Verification?

blocks.en: Multi-view provides a practical protocol for 3D verification. Multi-view representation generally performs better than raw 3D input, indicating that rendering 3D evidence into views is currently a more effective way to elicit reliable judgments from existing MLLMs. We compare multi-view RGB and raw OBJ input on matched Object, Part, and Material subsets in Table 3 (a). The multi-view results are also broadly consistent with the corresponding results in Table 1 . This choice preserves the core difficulty of 3D verification, requiring models to aggregate partial observations, resolve occlusions, associate parts across views, and disentangle underlying geometry from viewpoint or appearance changes. As an early benchmark for 3D verifiers, 3DVerifierBench therefore adopts multi-view rendering as a practical and extensible protocol for grounding verification in 3D content.
blocks.zh: 多视图为3D验证提供了实用协议. 多视图代表一般表现优于原始的3D输入,表明将3D证据放入观点是目前从现有的MLLMs中获取可靠判断的更有效方式. 我们比较表3(a)中对应对象、部分和材料子集的多视图RGB和原始OBJ输入。 多视图结果也与表1中的相应结果大体一致. 这一选择保留了3D校验的核心难度,要求模型汇总部分观测,解决隔离,关联部分跨观点,从视角或外观变化中分解出基础几何. 作为3D验证器的早期基准,3D验证器Bench因此采用了多视图渲染,作为三维内容中基于验证的实用而可扩展的协议.

For motion, no single representation is always the best. Motion verification requires both temporal dynamics and geometric evidence. We evaluate three representations on the Motion Understanding task in Table 3 (b): 16 uniformly sampled frames, raw 3D motion in .obj sequences, and native video. We report binary and 4-class Accuracy.
No single representation consistently outperforms others across all models and metrics. Native video is the highest in binary (59.7%), whereas 16-frames yield the highest in 4-class (43.8%). The preferred representation also varies by model: Gemini-3.8-Flash benefits most from native video, whereas Qwen3.6-35B-A3B excels with .obj sequences. These results show that denser temporal evidence alone does not guarantee superior motion verification; rather, performance depends on a model’s ability to extract and integrate spatio-temporal cues. Consequently, we adopt native video / 16-frame sampling as the default settings of our benchmark.

blocks.en: 5.5 How Can Verification Feedback Help 3D Generation Models Reflect?
blocks.zh: 5.5 核查反馈如何有助于三维生成模型的反射?

blocks.en: We examine how reliable verification feedback can help 3D systems reflect on their outputs. Parallel selection measures the value of recognizing successful candidates, while human-guided recursive refinement examines how explicit failure feedback can guide subsequent revisions.
blocks.zh: 我们审查可靠的核查反馈如何能够帮助三维系统反映其产出。 平行的甄选衡量认可成功候选人的价值,而由人指导的递归性改进则审查明确的失败反馈如何指导随后的修订。

blocks.en:
Parallel selection. For 40 source images, we fix seven factual requirements before generation and obtain eight candidates each from Pixal3D and Hunyuan3D-2.1 ( Team Hunyuan3D et al., 2025 ) , forming a sixteen-candidate pool per input. All candidates are reviewed by multiple humans with adjudication.
Table 4 shows that human-oracle selection raises full factual success from 26.7% under uniform random selection to 90.0%, while Strict Full rises from 16.6% to 85.0%.
Selection by GPT-6 Astra
also improves over random, approaches human-level performance in factual success rate, but stays below the human oracle.
Thus, the oracle results quantify the selection headroom available from reliable verification rather than the performance of an existing automatic verifier.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusion To reflect on a 3D output, a system must determine whether it meets its requirements and explain any violations. 3DVerifierBench shows that current models often struggle to provide this feedback, even when generated content looks plausible. Answer, explanation, and counterfactual-consistency evaluations reveal failures to identify decisive facts, their targets, and relevant contradictions. Our construction pipeline provides structured data to support training on these distinctions. Human-oracle selection and human-guided refinement illustrate how better feedback can help select and revise 3D assets, although satisfying explicit facts does not ensure overall quality or source fidelity. These findings motivate more reliable evidence-grounded feedback for future 3D generation systems.
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论 为了反思三维产出,一个系统必须确定它是否符合要求并解释任何违规行为。 3D验证器 Bench 显示,当前的模型往往难以提供这种反馈,即使生成的内容看起来是合理的. 答案,解释,以及反事实一致性评价揭示出未能识别决定性事实,其目标,相关矛盾. 我们的建造管道提供结构化数据,支持关于这些区别的培训。 人-甲骨文选择和以人为指南的完善说明,更好的反馈如何有助于选择和修订三维资产,尽管满足明确的事实并不能确保整体质量或源的忠诚。 这些调查结果促使为未来的三维生成系统提供更可靠的循证反馈。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: To reflect on a 3D output, a system must determine whether it meets its requirements and explain any violations. 3DVerifierBench shows that current models often struggle to provide this feedback, even when generated content looks plausible. Answer, explanation, and counterfactual-consistency evaluations reveal failures to identify decisive facts, their targets, and relevant contradictions. Our construction pipeline provides structured data to support training on these distinctions. Human-oracle selection and human-guided refinement illustrate how better feedback can help select and revise 3D assets, although satisfying explicit facts does not ensure overall quality or source fidelity. These findings motivate more reliable evidence-grounded feedback for future 3D generation systems.
blocks.zh: 为了反思三维产出,一个系统必须确定它是否符合要求并解释任何违规行为。 3D验证器 Bench 显示,当前的模型往往难以提供这种反馈,即使生成的内容看起来是合理的. 答案,解释,以及反事实一致性评价揭示出未能识别决定性事实,其目标,相关矛盾. 我们的建造管道提供结构化数据,支持关于这些区别的培训。 人-甲骨文选择和以人为指南的完善说明,更好的反馈如何有助于选择和修订三维资产,尽管满足明确的事实并不能确保整体质量或源的忠诚。 这些调查结果促使为未来的三维生成系统提供更可靠的循证反馈。

The release contains 1,123 benchmark source groups and 4,011 training source groups, with zero source-group overlap. Source asset keys, declared asset hashes, and known-duplicate groups also have zero benchmark–training overlap. Per-task source-group counts in Table A1 are not additive because a source group can contribute to multiple tasks.

blocks.en: C.4 Motion-Issue Accuracy

blocks.en: Motion Understanding four-class Exact is correct only when the binary answer and primary issue match the reviewed label. Its classes are Correct , Unnatural Motion , Incorrect Motion , and Deformation Artifacts . Four-class Macro Recall averages recall across these classes. Joint explanation recall within an issue requires both a correct rejection and an accepted explanation, and differs from binary rejection recall.

blocks.en: For the ten-task main results, we use 10,000 bootstrap replicates. Native clusters are resampled independently within each task, retaining linked branches together; task scores are then averaged with equal weight. Fine-grained Geometry positives and negatives are resampled jointly by T-LESS object pair. Shared cluster draws are used across models. Table E2 reports marginal intervals, not significance tests for arbitrary model pairs.

blocks.en: Fact-level analysis retains the original claim as input and assigns the decision-relevant property to one of thirteen factual categories. blocks.en: Appendix F Scope and Release
blocks.zh: 附录F 范围和发布

blocks.en: The benchmark evaluates task-specific evidence from finite views, marked regions, reference comparisons, and animations. Material labels concern visible appearance, and affordance and grasp labels follow the source task rules. Fine-grained Geometry covers thirty objects; Motion Understanding includes both video and frame-sheet inputs. The text-only explanation Judge measures reference agreement, while targeted human inspection checks two specific defect sets. The recursive study uses human feedback and matches output counts rather than computation or human effort. We focus on evaluating verification performance and introducing a structured training resource to support downstream model optimization, which opens rich avenues for future work to explore verifier training.
blocks.zh: 基准从有限的观点、标记区域、参考比较和动画的角度评价具体任务的证据。 材料标签涉及明显的外观,支付和抓取标签遵循源任务规则。 精细的几何覆盖了30个对象; 运动理解包括视频和帧表输入. 仅限文本的解释 法官衡量参考协议,同时有针对性地检查两套具体的缺陷。 递归性研究使用人类反馈,匹配产出计数,而不是计算或人类努力. 我们侧重于评估核查业绩并引入结构化培训资源,以支持下游模式优化,从而为今后探索核查人员培训的工作开辟了丰富途径。

blocks.en: The release contains two distinct resources: the 2,581-example, ten-task evaluation benchmark and a 14,126-example, seven-task source-disjoint Training Resource. The Training Resource contains 4,011 source groups, 5,660 True anchors, and 8,466 False examples; benchmark source groups and all descendants are excluded, yielding zero benchmark–training source-group overlap. Released manifests retain source indices and pair/triplet links so that counts, grouping, and linkage structure can be recomputed. Source assets and annotations remain subject to their upstream licenses.

blocks.en: G.2 Public Image Conditions and Fixed Requirements
blocks.zh: G.2 公共图像条件和固定要求

blocks.en: The generation study uses forty source images from the public image-prompt collection shared by 3DGen-Bench and Hi3DBench. Screening retains complete objects with sufficient visible local facts. Existing Hi3DBench quality labels define four historical strata, with ten sources from each.
blocks.zh: 生成研究使用了由3DGen-Bench和Hi3DBench共享的公共图像-即时集的40个源图像. 筛选保留具有足够可见的局部事实的完整对象. 现有的Hi3DBench质量标签定义了4个历史等级,每个等级都有10个来源.

blocks.en: Human annotators define and review seven claims for each source: one identity claim and six local requirements covering counts, parts, geometry, relations, region binding, and surface appearance. Source images, claim text, and pass criteria are fixed before generation. This requirement-definition stage is separate from the subsequent human review of generated candidates.
blocks.zh: 人类注释员为每个来源界定和审查7项索赔:1项身份索赔和6项当地要求,涉及计数、零件、几何、关系、区域约束和表面外观。 原始图像、索赔文本和通过标准在生成之前是固定的。 这一要求界定阶段与随后对产生的候选人进行人文审查分开。

blocks.en: Each generator provides eight candidates per source, giving 640 assets in total. Hunyuan3D-2.1 uses the Shape-v2-1 + Paint-v2-1 run. Both generators share forty input images and 280 fixed claims. Candidates are rendered with eight 512-by-512 RGB views.

blocks.en: Multiple human reviewers assess the seven facts, severe defects, and fidelity to the source image. Disagreements are resolved through adjudication before scoring. The final annotation set contains 4,480 fact judgments and 640 labels for each asset-level field. All pooled selection metrics use this final set.

blocks.en: G.5 Human-Guided Recursive Refinement

blocks.en: The separate recursive experiment uses eight inputs with an unsuccessful initial Hunyuan3D-2.1 candidate. Parallel evaluation has eight independent candidates per input. Recursive refinement starts from the same first candidate and retains all seven facts. A human verifier identifies unmet requirements and supplies the next edit instruction. The updated 2D condition is realized by Hunyuan3D-2.1 regeneration or VecSet-Edit, with a mask when needed. Verification is repeated on the new asset.

blocks.en: Appendix H Fine-Grained Facts and Explanation Reliability
blocks.zh: 附录H 精确事实和解释的可靠性

blocks.en: H.1 Analysis Procedure
blocks.zh: H.1 分析程序

blocks.en: Motivated by fact-oriented evaluation in DSG and FActScore ( Cho et al., 2024 ; Min et al., 2023 ) , we group existing verification decisions by their decision-relevant factual property. Fine Fact labels organize this analysis; the original claim remains the model input, and no new subject-model queries are created.
blocks.zh: 根据DSG和FActScore(Cho等人,2024年;Min等人,2023年)中注重事实的评价,我们用与决定有关的事实财产来划分现有的核查决定。 Fine Fact 标签组织这一分析;原索赔仍然是模型输入,没有创建新的主题模型查询.

blocks.en: The assignment contains 1,778 verification units: 1,444 paired comparisons, 200 Identity comparisons, and 134 Motion Understanding sequences. These yield 3,222 decision incidences per model, with 1,611 True and 1,611 False. Anchors can recur across pairs. Fine-grained Geometry contributes thirty object pairs and sixty decisions. These content-based analysis units differ from distinct benchmark examples and from the eligible comparisons used for consistency scoring.
blocks.zh: 该任务包括1 778个核查单位:1 444个对等比较、200个身份比较和134个运动理解序列。 这些结果导致每个模型有3 222起决定事件,其中1 611起为真,1 611起为假。 锚可以重复成对。 精细的几何学贡献了30个对象对和60个决定. 这些基于内容的分析单元不同于不同的基准实例,也不同于用于一致性评分的合格比较。

Identity preservation differs from identity/existence: the former compares identity before and after editing, while the latter concerns category or presence in a single verification relation.

blocks.en: H.4 Observable Errors and Fine Facts
blocks.zh: H.4 可观察到的错误和事实

blocks.en: Table H4: Answer errors and reference-Judge failures by factual category, pooled across ten models. Error share is the fraction of all answer errors; Judge failures count reference-mismatched explanations among correct rejections.
blocks.zh: 表H4:按事实类别分列的答错和参考法官失误,共有10个模式。 出错共享是所有答错的分数; 法官失败计算出正确拒绝时的参照比对解释.

blocks.en: Action compatibility, shape/geometry, and region binding contribute the largest shares of answer errors: 18.7%, 16.2%, and 11.4%, respectively. These volumes depend on both category size and error rate; they are distinct from explanation mismatches among correct rejections.
blocks.zh: 动作相容性,形状/几何,以及区域绑定,分别贡献了18.7%,16.2%和11.4%的答错比例. 这些卷既取决于类别大小,也取决于出错率;它们与正确拒绝中的解释不匹配不同.

blocks.en: An incorrect fact/value states the wrong property or state. Incorrect target/binding associates a property with the wrong entity or region. Vague reasons do not localize a checkable contradiction. These distinctions describe observable mistakes in reviewed cases, rather than a separately quantified taxonomy of error mechanisms. Tables H4 – H6 report fact-grouped answer errors and reference-semantic Judge outcomes.
blocks.zh: 一个错误的事实/值表示错误的财产或状态。 目标/约束不正确将财产与错误的实体或区域联系起来。 模糊的原因不能将可校正的矛盾本地化. 这些区别描述的是经审查的案件中可观察到的错误,而不是对错误机制进行单独量化的分类。 表H4 – H6报告事实分组的答案错误和参考语义法官结果.

blocks.zh: 表H6:参考语义 按任务判断失败,汇集十个模式。 计数是指模型响应,而不是不同的资产.

blocks.en: Across the ten models, 3,462 of 9,488 correct rejections fail the reference-semantic Judge (36.5%). Astra’s rate is 12.9%, and GPT-5.6-Sol’s is 17.9%. The task-wise rates reach 100.0% for Fine-grained Geometry, 68.7% for Motion Understanding, and 64.1% for Identity.
blocks.zh: 在10个模式中,9 488个正确的拒绝中,3 462个没有通过参考语义法官(36.5%)。 Astra的比率为12.9%,GPT-5.6-Sol的比率为17.9%。 精细几何的作业率达到100.0%,运动理解为68.7%,身份识别为64.1%。

blocks.en: H.6 Representative Failure Cases of GPT-6 Astra
blocks.zh: H.6 代表GPT-6 Astra的失败案件

blocks.en: Figures 1 and 5 pair selected model responses with human-reviewed contradictions. These cases illustrate factual-value, target-binding, geometric, and motion errors.
blocks.zh: 图1和图5对有人为审查的矛盾的选定模式反应。 这些案件说明了事实价值、目标约束、几何和运动错误。

blocks.en: Part presence. Astra describes a rounded, arched suitcase handle even though the reviewed asset lacks a handle. The claimed component is absent rather than merely shaped differently.
blocks.zh: 部分存在. Astra描述了一个四舍五入,拱起的手提箱手柄,尽管被审查的资产缺乏手柄. 索赔部分没有,而只是作了不同的调整。

blocks.en: Region binding. The highlighted furniture region is the support box beneath the cushion. Astra instead describes the padded seating surface, binding a plausible property to the wrong part.
blocks.zh: 区域约束。 突出的家具区是垫下支撑箱. 相反,Astra描述了增加的座位表面,将一个可信的属性绑在错误的部分上。

blocks.en: Grasp contacts. Astra describes opposing contacts, whereas the displayed jaws lie on adjacent sides and the source label marks the grasp as invalid.
blocks.zh: 格拉斯普联系人 Astra描述的是对立的接触,而所显示的下巴则位于相邻的一侧,而源标签则标记了抓取无效.

blocks.en: Reference geometry. Astra accepts the candidate’s main geometry despite its fuller, outward-bowed middle, rounder cross-section, and wider side silhouette. References and rendered views localize the structural mismatch.
blocks.zh: 参考几何. Astra 接受候选人的主要几何学,尽管其更完整、更外向的中段、更圆的截面和更大的侧边斜线。 参考文献和观点将结构错配本地化。

blocks.en: Layer count. Astra repeats the claim’s six internal cake layers; the reviewed reference identifies seven. Correctly describing the topping does not resolve the count error.
blocks.zh: 层数. Astra重复索赔的6个内部蛋糕层;经审查的参考物确定了7个。 正确描述上加不能解决计数错误 。

blocks.en: Direct contact. Astra describes the cushion as resting directly against the marked backrest, while the reviewed part pair does not directly touch.
blocks.zh: 直接接触 Astra描述出衬垫被直接倒向被标记的后退,而被审查的部分对不直接触碰.

blocks.en: Material appearance. Astra recognizes beige mottling but calls the surface stone-like. The reviewed contradiction is its reflective, metallic appearance.
blocks.zh: 物质外观. Astra识别出米黄色起伏 但称表面为"石头" 经审查的矛盾在于其反射出金属外观.

blocks.en: Affordance. Astra accepts pressing for the highlighted camera dial, although human review confirms that this region does not support pressing.
blocks.zh: 供养. Astra接受按下突出的相机拨号,不过人文审查证实这个区域不支持按下.

blocks.en: Motion naturalness and deformation. In Figure 1 , Astra recognizes the rightward collapse but misses the nearly rigid fall and limited leg response. In the sleeping sequence in Figure 5 , it accepts the motion as natural despite forelimb–muzzle fusion. Both cases use sixteen-frame inputs.
blocks.zh: 运动自然与变形. 在图1中,Astra承认右向倒塌,但错过了近乎僵硬的倒塌和有限的腿部反应. 在图5的睡眠序列中,它接受运动是自然的,尽管前额-口袋聚变。 这两个案例都使用了16个框架的投入。
